settings.title: Portfolio
settings.lead: Show work you’ve already done. Companies see approved items on your profile, and you can attach up to {max} when you apply.
settings.emptyLead: Add a screenshot of a story, a photo from a shoot or a Reel cover.
settings.limit: You’ve added the maximum of {max} items. Delete one to add another.
settings.reviewNote: We check each item before companies see it. Editing an approved item sends it back to review.
settings.deleteBody: It disappears from your profile and from applications it was attached to.

form.imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. A story screenshot works too.
